fields.name: schema_version
fields.definition: Semantic schema version of the row.

fields.name: engine_version
fields.definition: Plaiq and Matrix versions that produced the row.

fields.name: event_id
fields.definition: Opaque event id, derived from the event's content; cited, never quoted.

fields.name: match_id
fields.definition: Opaque match key (m1_...), never the provider's id.

fields.name: event_idx
fields.definition: The loader's row position; internal, for joins only.

fields.name: timestamp_s
fields.definition: Match clock at the action's start.

fields.name: minute_display
fields.definition: The match minute as mm:ss.

fields.name: period
fields.definition: Period of play (1, 2; 3 and 4 in extra time).

fields.name: actor_player_ref
fields.definition: The acting player as side and shirt number (home_10); the client adds the name from the club's roster.

fields.name: actor_team
fields.definition: home or away.

fields.name: actor_role
fields.definition: The actor's role: the club's roster where given, else P2's main role for the match.
fields.evidence: roles agree with SkillCorner's positions 83% grouped, 90% merged, pooled over 583 players (measured on a development set; CONTEXT_STRUCTURE_REPORT.md)

fields.name: actor_role_source
fields.definition: Where actor_role came from: roster or estimated.

fields.name: action_type
fields.definition: pass, carry, shot, turnover, defensive_action, set_piece, foul_won, card, or run (run rows are P6's estimate).

fields.name: action_outcome
fields.definition: completed or lost (passes, carries), won or lost (defensive actions), the shot's outcome where the feed gives one.

fields.name: action_detail
fields.definition: The feed's subtype in Ponta's words: header, set-piece kind, dispossessed, clearance, offside, card colour.

fields.name: target_player_ref
fields.definition: The logged receiver of a pass (side and shirt number).

fields.name: inferred_intended_ref
fields.definition: The engine's inferred intended receiver of a failed pass.

fields.name: inference_confidence
fields.definition: How strongly the intended receiver is inferred (weak, medium, strong).

fields.name: dq_score
fields.definition: Gain (decision quality version 1): forward movement on the threat surface relative to the passer's position.
fields.evidence: measured against outcomes and providers' analogues, not against analysts; construct validity untested; the passer is the best option in about 65% of scored passes (PLAIQ_REFERENCES_REPORT.md)

fields.name: dq_band
fields.definition: Gain's band: low_gain, partial_gain, most_gain, full_gain, or not_scored.
fields.evidence: measured against outcomes and providers' analogues, not against analysts; construct validity untested; the passer is the best option in about 65% of scored passes (PLAIQ_REFERENCES_REPORT.md)

fields.name: chosen_option_pov
fields.definition: Pass option value of the option the passer chose.
fields.evidence: availability predicts completion at AUC 0.77; value tracks SkillCorner's threat at 0.78 (measured on a development set; PLAIQ_REFERENCES_REPORT.md)

fields.name: best_option_player_ref
fields.definition: The team-mate with the highest pass option value at release.
fields.evidence: availability predicts completion at AUC 0.77; value tracks SkillCorner's threat at 0.78 (measured on a development set; PLAIQ_REFERENCES_REPORT.md)

fields.name: best_option_pov
fields.definition: The highest pass option value on offer at release.
fields.evidence: availability predicts completion at AUC 0.77; value tracks SkillCorner's threat at 0.78 (measured on a development set; PLAIQ_REFERENCES_REPORT.md)

fields.name: xt_delta
fields.definition: Change in threat (value surface) from the action's start to its end.
fields.evidence: the value surface tracks SkillCorner's threat at 0.78 (measured on a development set; PLAIQ_REFERENCES_REPORT.md)

fields.name: movement_value
fields.definition: Off-ball movement value (null in this table since schema 2.1; see movement_values).

fields.name: opposition_pressure
fields.definition: 1v1 pressure on the actor at the action's start.
fields.evidence: 1v1 pressure against SkillCorner's five pressure levels: weighted kappa 0.80 (measured on a development set; PLAIQ_REFERENCES_REPORT.md)

fields.name: pitch_zone
fields.definition: Channel and third of the action's start, in the actor's attacking direction.

fields.name: mode
fields.definition: Analysis mode (full_tracking).

fields.name: pass_completion_probability
fields.definition: Estimated probability the pass is completed.
fields.evidence: log-loss 0.327, AUC 0.843 on SkillCorner's matches (SkillCorner's own model 0.894; measured on a development set; PLAIQ_REFERENCES_REPORT.md)

fields.name: pass_completion_status
fields.definition: estimated, or why the pass has no completion probability.

fields.name: pass_completion_parameters
fields.definition: The fitted parameter set used.

fields.name: dq_v2_score
fields.definition: Choice (decision quality version 2): how the chosen option compared with the best on offer.
fields.evidence: measured against outcomes and SkillCorner's analogue, not against analysts (PLAIQ_REFERENCES_REPORT.md)

fields.name: dq_v2_band
fields.definition: Choice's band: best_option, near_best, below_best, well_below_best (never Gain's names).
fields.evidence: measured against outcomes and SkillCorner's analogue, not against analysts (PLAIQ_REFERENCES_REPORT.md)

fields.name: dq_v2_status
fields.definition: estimated, or why Choice is not scored.

fields.name: dq_v2_best_option_ref
fields.definition: The best option by Choice (side and shirt number).
fields.evidence: measured against outcomes and SkillCorner's analogue, not against analysts (PLAIQ_REFERENCES_REPORT.md)

fields.name: dq_v2_version
fields.definition: Choice's version.

fields.name: gain_v2_score
fields.definition: Gain version 2: the realised value of the pass over the best option's expected value.
fields.evidence: measured against outcomes and SkillCorner's analogue, not against analysts (PLAIQ_REFERENCES_REPORT.md)

fields.name: gain_v2_band
fields.definition: Gain version 2's band, on version 1's cut-offs and names.
fields.evidence: measured against outcomes and SkillCorner's analogue, not against analysts (PLAIQ_REFERENCES_REPORT.md)

fields.name: gain_v2_status
fields.definition: estimated, or why Gain version 2 is not scored.

fields.name: gain_v2_version
fields.definition: Gain version 2's version.

fields.name: not_scored
fields.definition: True when the decision is deliberately not scored (goalkeeper, set piece, lost pass for Gain).

fields.name: not_scored_reason
fields.definition: Why it is not scored.

fields.name: run_type
fields.definition: A run's type in SkillCorner's vocabulary (run rows only).
fields.evidence: 75% to 80% of SkillCorner's runs found; run type kappa 0.41 (measured on a development set; CONTEXT_RELATIONSHIPS_REPORT.md)

fields.name: run_area
fields.definition: Where the run ends against the defending units: in_front, in_between or in_behind (FIFA's categories).
